To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the faulty-line-cover algorithm is more efficient than the fault-driven technique for the repair of RRAMs; 2) the coefficient-based technique for the repair RRAMs is very fast and efficient; 3) a new approach for the repair of defective RAMs, namely, the row/column deletion approach, is introduced; and 4) the row/column deletion technique is very efficient and is applicable to any memory organization.
the two proposed approaches for the repair are fast, and they achieve acceptable yield for the redundant RAMs.

1) the faulty-line-cover approach will execute much faster than the fault-driven approach under all fault distributions, 2) the heuristic approach will execute even faster than the faulty-line-cover algorithm, 3) the heuristic approach can be applied to any fault distribution, and 4) the coefficient selection techniques are efficient and can be easily applied in practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of efficient techniques for the repair of redundant RAMs.
the design of efficient algorithms for the repair of RAMs with redundant rows and columns.
the design and analysis of a class of algorithms for the repair of RRAMs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a very good overview of two repair techniques for VLSI/ WSI RAMs.
both approaches can be used to repair large RAMs.
both the faulty-line-cover and the heuristic criterion are effective repair algorithms for the redundant RAMs, with the faulty-line-cover algorithm being more efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed two approaches to repair redundant RAMs.
we have presented a new technique for the repair of redundant RAMs that will execute much faster than the fault-driven technique and that it will find the optimal repair-solutions.
we presented two repair techniques for redundant RRAMs, namely, the fault-driven technique, and the faulty-line-coverer and efficient coefficient techniques.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the repair of VSI/WSI RRs can be done in a very efficient manner.
the repair of redundant RAMs is possible in a reasonable time and at a very low cost.
the faulty-line covering technique is a good alternative to the fault-driven technique.
